headline: Midwestern State outscore every other programme in the division
dek: Two matches into the season, Midwestern State have scored eleven goals and conceded one. The 28 other programmes across the Gulf South, the Great American and the Lone Star have all scored fewer, and no conference has yet opened its own play.
